answer: A decentralized economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by requiring each participant to stake verifiable compute resources to an immutable anchor on-chain. This cryptographically binds every active agent identity to a unique hardware-backed genesis block, conceptually seeding a verifiable nebula of trusted nodes. Consequently, deploying fake identities ceases to be trivial; an attacker must incur prohibitive capital and energy costs equivalent to cultivating a massive, resource-intensive orchard of dedicated processing units for every single spurious agent attempted.
